orders_protection_check.name: orders_protection_check
orders_protection_check.value:
CASE "orders"."time_in_force"
        WHEN 'gtc' THEN "orders"."protected_limit_price" = "orders"."limit_price"
          AND "orders"."reference_price" IS NULL AND "orders"."protection_ticks" IS NULL
        ELSE CASE WHEN "orders"."protection_ticks" IS NULL
          THEN "orders"."reference_price" IS NULL AND "orders"."protected_limit_price" = "orders"."limit_price"
            AND "orders"."reject_reason" IS NOT NULL
            AND "orders"."reject_reason"::text IN ('not_open_yet', 'paused', 'closed', 'ledger_hold', 'admin_role_revoked')
          ELSE ("orders"."reference_price" IS NULL AND "orders"."protected_limit_price" = "orders"."limit_price")
            OR ("orders"."side" = 'buy' AND "orders"."protected_limit_price"
                = LEAST("orders"."limit_price", "orders"."reference_price" + "orders"."protection_ticks", 99))
            OR ("orders"."side" = 'sell' AND "orders"."protected_limit_price"
                = GREATEST("orders"."limit_price", "orders"."reference_price" - "orders"."protection_ticks", 1))
          END
        END

orders_status_check.name: orders_status_check
orders_status_check.value:
CASE "orders"."status"
        WHEN 'open' THEN "orders"."filled_qty" = 0
        WHEN 'partially_filled' THEN "orders"."qty" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."filled_qty" > 0
          AND "orders"."filled_qty" < "orders"."qty"
        WHEN 'filled' THEN CASE WHEN "orders"."qty" IS NULL THEN "orders"."filled_qty" >= 1
          ELSE "orders"."filled_qty" = "orders"."qty" END
        WHEN 'cancelled' THEN ("orders"."qty" IS NULL OR "orders"."filled_qty" < "orders"."qty")
          AND ("orders"."time_in_force" = 'gtc' OR "orders"."filled_qty" >= 1)
        WHEN 'expired' THEN "orders"."time_in_force" = 'gtc' AND "orders"."qty" IS NOT NULL
          AND "orders"."filled_qty" < "orders"."qty"
        ELSE "orders"."filled_qty" = 0
        END
        AND ("orders"."status" = 'rejected') = ("orders"."reject_reason" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("orders"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("orders"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("orders"."status" IN ('open', 'partially_filled')) = ("orders"."ended_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("orders"."status" NOT IN ('open', 'partially_filled') OR ("orders"."time_in_force" = 'gtc' AND "orders"."qty" IS NOT NULL))
